title: Suspect Mugshot - Darren Kuczma (Booking Photo)
prompt:
1) Function (1 sentence)
Create a neutral, professional booking-style mugshot photograph of a fictitious adult suspect for case documentation.

2) Scene / Composition (3–5 sentences; include subject percentage in frame)
Eye-level, centered head-and-shoulders portrait against a plain matte light-gray backdrop with no markings. The subject is a fictitious adult male with generic features (no resemblance to any real person), neutral expression, eyes forward, mouth closed, no visible tattoos, and no distinctive scars. Clothing is a plain, unbranded dark crew-neck shirt with no text or logos. Subject occupies ~65% of the frame, with modest headroom and shoulders visible.

3) Angle & Distance (strict numeric values)
Angle: 0° (straight-on). Subject distance: 1.30 m from camera.

4) Optics & Technique (lens mm, f/, 1/x s, ISO, WB K, focus, DOF)
Lens: 70 mm (full-frame equivalent). Aperture: f/5.6. Shutter: 1/125 s. ISO: 200. White balance: 5000K. Focus locked on the eyes; moderate depth of field with ears slightly softer but face fully sharp.

5) Mandatory elements (labels/markers/timestamps already present in the case)
None.

6) Negatives (objective list of what MUST NOT appear)
No real person or identifiable celebrity likeness; no faces of additional people; no fingerprints/biometrics overlays; no police badges, patches, insignia, ID boards, booking number placards, barcodes, or watermarks; no readable names or the title text in-frame; no logos/brands; no timestamps; no background signage; no harsh shadows; no weapons; no injuries or blood.

7) Acceptance checklist (objective, verifiable bullets)
- Single color documentary photo, professional quality, even frontal lighting.
- Eye-level straight-on portrait with plain light-gray background and no text/markings.
- Unbranded dark crew-neck shirt; no logos or readable text anywhere.
- Subject fills ~65% of the frame; neutral expression; eyes forward.
- Technical metadata matches: 70mm, f/5.6, 1/125s, ISO 200, WB 5000K.
- No timestamps, placards, badges, or identifiers appear in the image.
